SharedTrip.title: SharedTrip
SharedTrip.description: Represents a collaborative packing trip list shared between travelers

id.description: Trip identifier or share code (e.g. SOMMER-2026 or UUID)

shareCode.description: Human readable uppercase share code for easy collaboration

date.description: Start date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

people.description: JSON serialized list of Person objects including items and packed status

communityBox.description: JSON serialized list of community items and packed status

weatherInfo.description: JSON serialized cached weather data and triggers

lastUpdatedBy.description: Name of the person who last edited or checked an item

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when trip was last updated

/trips/{tripId}.description: Collection of collaborative trips synced between users in real time
